about: The Android permissions of Automatos Go, as data (R08, KR12). allowed is exactly the uses-permission set the evaluated Android manifest keeps (npx expo config --type introspect on the merged base 24a8fa6, 26 Oct 2026): app.json android.permissions plus what each wired config plugin adds, each with why the app needs it and the module that asks for it. denied is what the build must never keep: the ones app.json android.blockedPermissions removes (tools:node="remove", which also strips them from a library's manifest at merge time) and the ones no module declares. src/release/__tests__/permissions.test.ts holds the evaluated manifest and every installed library's AndroidManifest.xml to this file, so a plugin or library that adds a permission fails CI. Gradle dependencies (LiveKit's audioswitch and WebRTC, Firebase messaging, ML Kit barcode scanning, clerk-android, sentry-android) bring manifests that are not in node_modules: only the built APK shows their merged result (OT-R5). docs/native-modules.md 'Android permissions' is the foundation's record of the same list.

allowed.name: android.permission.INTERNET
allowed.why: The Automatos API, Clerk sign-in, Auto Live (LiveKit) and crash reports (Sentry).

allowed.name: android.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE
allowed.why: Connectivity checks before a request, a call or an over-the-air update.

allowed.name: android.permission.CAMERA
allowed.why: Scanning the QR code that pairs the app with your own server, and taking a photo to send to Auto. Asked when Camera is first used, never at launch.

allowed.name: android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO
allowed.why: Quick-ask speech to text and Auto Live calls. The microphone is open only while you hold to talk or are in a call, never in the background (D33).

allowed.name: android.permission.MODIFY_AUDIO_SETTINGS
allowed.why: Routing Auto Live audio to the speaker or a headset.

allowed.name: android.permission.BLUETOOTH
allowed.why: Auto Live through a Bluetooth headset (LiveKit's audioswitch). A normal permission: no prompt.

allowed.name: android.permission.BLUETOOTH_ADMIN
allowed.why: Auto Live through a Bluetooth headset (LiveKit's audioswitch). A normal permission: no prompt.

allowed.name: android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS
allowed.why: Push notifications: questions, reviews and Auto's messages. Android 13 and later ask, after the app has first been used, never at launch.

allowed.name: android.permission.RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED
allowed.why: expo-notifications' boot receiver re-arms scheduled notifications after the phone restarts.

allowed.name: android.permission.WAKE_LOCK
allowed.why: Keeps an Auto Live call running while the screen is on and the app is open.

allowed.name: android.permission.USE_BIOMETRIC
allowed.why: The optional fingerprint or face check before you approve or answer (a setting).

allowed.name: android.permission.USE_FINGERPRINT
allowed.why: The same check on Android versions before the biometric API.

allowed.name: android.permission.VIBRATE
allowed.why: A light tap when a message is sent and when the style changes.

allowed.name: android.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE
allowed.why: expo-image-picker's launchCameraAsync asks for it with the camera below Android 10 (ImagePickerModule.kt ensureCameraPermissionsAreGranted), and the minimum is Android 7 (API 24). Android 10 and later never ask; the photo is written to the app's own cache, not to shared storage.
allowed.module: expo-image-picker; also the Expo template, expo-file-system

denied.name: android.permission.READ_MEDIA_IMAGES
denied.why: Google Play allows it only for apps whose core purpose needs broad photo access. Photos are chosen in the system photo picker (expo-image-picker's PickVisualMedia, never the legacy picker), which needs no permission. Blocked in app.json.

denied.name: android.permission.READ_MEDIA_VIDEO
denied.why: As READ_MEDIA_IMAGES; the app attaches no video. Blocked in app.json.

denied.name: android.permission.READ_MEDIA_AUDIO
denied.why: The app reads no audio files from the phone. Blocked in app.json.

denied.name: android.permission.READ_MEDIA_VISUAL_USER_SELECTED
denied.why: Android 14's partial photo access: the system photo picker needs no media permission at all. No module declares it; not blocked in app.json, so the APK check (OT-R5) confirms no Gradle dependency adds it.

denied.name: android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE
denied.why: expo-image-picker and expo-file-system declare it, but the system photo picker and the system document picker hand over only what was chosen. Blocked in app.json.

denied.name: android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION
denied.why: The app uses no location. Blocked in app.json, because Gradle dependencies bring manifests this repository cannot inspect.

denied.name: android.permission.READ_CONTACTS
denied.why: The app reads no contacts. Blocked in app.json.

denied.name: android.permission.WRITE_CONTACTS
denied.why: The app writes no contacts. Blocked in app.json.

denied.name: android.permission.SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW
denied.why: The app draws over no other app. The Expo template and the WebRTC config plugin add it; blocked in app.json.

denied.name: android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE
denied.why: No background microphone or call (D33): Auto Live runs with the screen on and the app open. LiveKit's library manifest declares it; blocked in app.json, so no foreground service can start.

denied.name: android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MICROPHONE
denied.why: No background microphone (D33). No module declares it; not blocked in app.json, so the APK check (OT-R5) confirms no Gradle dependency adds it.

denied.name: android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PROJECTION
denied.why: The app never shares the screen. @livekit/react-native-webrtc's library manifest declares a MediaProjectionService with foregroundServiceType mediaProjection but not this permission; with FOREGROUND_SERVICE blocked the service can never run in the foreground. Not blocked in app.json: the APK check (OT-R5) confirms it is absent. If a future Play Console asks for a foreground-service declaration because of that service, the answer is that the app never starts it.

denied.name: android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PLAYBACK
denied.why: No background audio (D33): Auto's server voice (expo-audio) plays only with the app open and on the screen. expo-audio's library manifest declares it for its lock-screen controls service (AudioControlsService), which the app never starts; expo-video's config plugin adds it only with supportsBackgroundPlayback, which app.json sets false. Blocked in app.json.
